seal.statement: Owner decision 2026-10-04: every change under src/ reaches the shared main branch only as a solver landing - a sealed quest landed with solve land, its change cone run and, as land already requires for src/, an independent verification; docs, tests, scripts and generated metadata may still be committed directly with a named witness. The work-unit threshold says so where it is owned (AGENTS.md Choose The Work Unit, solver-quests.md Choosing the unit, the runbook's commit-on-completion paragraph, R15's invariant text with its sealed id, slug and owner unchanged). It is enforced at the main push: every commit the pushed main sha brings over the remote main sha (the ancestry cut-off - nothing already on main is judged) whose own change touches a path under src/ (renames into or out of src/, deletions, type changes and the src entry itself included) must be a single-parent commit that appends to one quest log a terminal solved entry binding that commit's exact src/ raw diff (written by land's existing terminal-entry writer, append-only) in a log recording a seal and a current approving verification, or be brought by a merge admitted by an exact-SHA corpus-full-v1 or release-full-v1 receipt for the merge commit itself plus a Quest: trailer naming a sealed quest whose log at the merge records a current approving verification; a merge's own src/ change is what differs from every parent. Typed Quest/Epic/Sealed-At trailers admit nothing. The check is git plumbing (plus a receipt lookup only for a merge that needs one), runs in the pre-push hook first among the content stages and only for a push that updates main, and names each refused commit with its src/ paths; a branch push stays a free preservation action. Land also judges the landing quest's own record before any proof: the closed-quest composition as if closed (refusing each file the sealed claim does not require) and the append-only history of every quest log it would commit, leaving the index untouched on refusal. Witnessed red-first on the real solve CLI, the real land and the real hook over scratch repositories.

text: History pass + census of landing signals and their forgeability (origin/main d60c30921). Signals a v2 land commit carries: (1) message trailers Quest/Epic/Sealed-At (commands.js commitLanding) - typed text, forgeable by anyone; they bind nothing to the tree and are NOT read by the admission. (2) the quest directory in the commit's own tree: quest.json, a seal entry, attempts, a verification entry, and the terminal solved entry land appends (commands.js land) - before this quest the terminal entry recorded only pathCount and a 50-path sample, no binding to the committed bytes, so a hand-typed entry was indistinguishable from land's. (3) evidence/receipt.json - reproducible by re-running the harness, not a landing signal. No signal is cryptographically unforgeable (no signing in this repo); the strongest in-tree binding is: a terminal solved entry NEW in the commit (appended to the parent's log bytes) whose recorded digest equals the commit's own src/ raw diff (modes, both blob ids, status, path; --no-renames), in a log with a seal and a current approving verification. Forging that requires fabricating seal + verification + a terminal entry carrying the exact digest - a deliberate, attributable R21/R23 violation, not an accident of following the old rule. The publisher's inert-data rebase changes parents but not the src/ diff, so the content binding survives it; a parent-SHA binding would not.

Census of how src/ reached main (git log --first-parent origin/main -n 200 -- src, classified by script): 10 v2 solver landings (trailer + new terminal entry, e.g. 003c65b89 ee8b47800); v1 solver landings (subject '<quest>: <statement>...' with v1 records, e.g. 0d749c1ff f95fccaf0) inside ~158 non-v2 single-parent commits that also hold the direct commits (ec63fbb00, 4f61b4a32, the 2026-09-13/16 formation-sim and rebalancer series); 8 release-preparation direct commits (0d66b0cb6 ...); 8 GitHub squash merges '(#NN)' (#46 f4f5b5a6e, #51, #52, #62, #63 1aea11baf which even carries a quest terminal entry, #65, #69) - created server-side, never met the pre-push hook; 3 merge commits (90f21f0e5, 3bf8ab9a8, 7d4d5d96e); publisher inert-data rebases (formation trend only, no src); --post-merge proves the corpus of a GitHub-merged head after the fact and judges nothing about landings. Long-lived branch: origin/finalize/zero-liferaft-2026-10-02 (087a9df0d, 261 commits over d60c30921, 2 internal clean merges, 66 commits touching src/, all direct; governing quest zero-liferaft-active-runtime whose newest verification is a REJECT followed by a corrective attempt).

Design (owner decision 2026-10-04 'every src/ change goes through solve land'). Owner of the predicate: the quest-lifecycle guard owner scripts/solve/guards.js (mainAdmission), reached as a read-only solve verb 'admit --base --head' (no new script); land's existing terminal-entry writer gains one field, source={pathCount,digest} of the staged src/ raw diff (stagedSourceChange), and the verification predicate moves unchanged from commands.js to guards.js so land and the admission ask one owner. Rule over base..head (base = remote main sha; ancestry is the cut-off - nothing reachable from it is judged; no date, no leniency for older entry shapes): a single-parent commit with a src/ change (pathspec 'src' with --no-renames: renames into/out of src/, deletions, type changes, the src entry itself) must be a landing as bound above; a merge's own src/ change is its combined diff (differs from every parent); a merge that has one, or that brings unlanded src/ commits (reachable from it, not from its first parent), is admitted - covering those commits - only with an exact-SHA corpus-full-v1 or release-full-v1 receipt for the merge commit itself (resolveProof, resolution exact-sha only; identity reuse refused; an unanswering store refuses) AND a Quest: trailer naming a quest whose record at the merge is sealed and whose log records a current approving verification. Enforcement point: .githooks/pre-push, inside the exact checkout, first content stage after identity, only when a ref updates refs/heads/main with a known remote sha, judging main's own local sha (not the first pushed ref); the publisher runs the same hook. Measured cost: 0.34 s for 50 commits, 1.1 s for 261. Bootstrap: this quest changes no src/; the first src/ landing after it carries a source binding from the new writer and is admitted; a commit landed by the OLD writer that is not yet on origin/main is refused and must be re-landed (ancestry cut-off, by design).

Long-lived branch admission reasoning and OPEN OWNER QUESTIONS. Why receipt+quest is at least land's cone+verification on the test axis: corpus-full-v1/release-full-v1 prove the whole behavioural corpus for the exact tree entering main (the merge commit), a superset of land's change cone measured on a base land picked. What it does NOT give, stated plainly: (Q1) independent verification of a 260-commit branch - the check only asks that the governing quest's log records a current approving verification; whether one verdict entry may stand for every commit the merge brings is an owner judgment no receipt can provide; (Q2) land's other guards are not re-run for a merge - the governing quest's doneWhen being green, the epic authorizes scope, the coupled-pair guard and the altitude budget (the push gate's own static stages do still run over the pushed range); (Q3) receipts are refs anyone with push access can create (proof-authority recordProof asks action-authority, locally) - forgeable at the same order as a typed log entry; (Q4) GitHub merges never meet the hook, so nothing in-repo refuses a src/ change arriving that way; only branch protection (outside the repo) could - recorded as a known owner gap in router.md; a CI step would detect it but costs workflow lines against an OVER budget (1265/500), so it is an owner decision, not taken here. For PR #73 today: a local merge M into main, an exact-SHA release-full-v1 (or corpus-full-v1) receipt for M, 'Quest: zero-liferaft-active-runtime' in M's message, and a new approving verification recorded after the 2026-10-03T22:10 corrective attempt; GitHub's merge button cannot satisfy it (M's sha does not exist before the merge).

Part B mechanism and census. closedQuestShapeOffences examines only quests already terminal; land ran every guard over pathsOutsideQuest (its own directory excluded) and appended the terminal entry only after the proof, so a quest holding an unrequired evidence file landed green and made the landed commit red (6929b84de, repaired 5768db879). Fix in the existing guard list: landingRecordProblems = compositionOffences(root, id) (exported from check-closed-quest-shape.js) judged as if closed, plus workingTreeOffences (exported from check-quest-log-append-only.js), before any staging or proof; refusal leaves the index untouched. Census of other closed-quest-only audits: the closed-quest MUTATION rule cannot fire on the landing (the quest is not closed at its parent); the append-only audit is not closed-quest-only but land never called it, so a committed quest log rewritten in the working tree would have been committed (red after landing) - closed by the same guard; no other check in package.json's quest audits examines only closed quests.

Red-first and mutation evidence. Witnesses: 11 tests in test/solve/commands.test.js driving the real solve CLI (main(argv, root)) and the real land over scratch repos (receipts are real proof-authority tags pushed to a bare remote), 2 in test/scripts/pre-push-hook-control-flow.test.js driving the real hook. On origin/main d60c30921 with only the witness files applied, 12 of 13 receipts red, each a behavioural assertion (admit exits 2 with usage; land does not refuse; the hook never calls admit); non-main-push-not-admitted green (a preservation witness). Mutations (scratch worktree, each restored): M1 binding digest not compared -> forged-signals red; M2 land stops writing the binding -> 4 red incl. real-landing-admitted; M3 verification not required -> landing-log-without-approval red; M4 any terminal, not one new in the commit -> forged-signals (replay) red; M5 merge receipt not required, M6 any resolution accepted -> long-lived-merge and hand-resolved-merge red; M7 governing quest not required, M8 brought commits not covered -> long-lived-merge red; M10 range not cut at the remote main -> 3 red; M11 first-parent instead of combined merge diff, M12 merge own paths ignored -> merge-of-landings red; M13 land shape guard removed -> both land witnesses red; M14 append-only part removed -> rewritten-log red; M15 stage removed, M17 stage after unused-files, M18 refusal ignored, M19 first pushed sha judged instead of main's -> main-push-admission red; M16 admission on every proved push -> non-main red. Survivor M9 (rename detection on): equivalent - land and the admission share RAW_SOURCE_DIFF, and under the src pathspec a rename across the src/ boundary degrades to an add or delete either way, so no outcome changes.

Attempt 1 at d60c30921 (whole delta staged, uncommitted): mainAdmission + verification predicate in scripts/solve/guards.js; land writes source binding and judges its own record (landingRecordProblems) in scripts/solve/commands.js; solve admit verb; pre-push solver-landing-admission stage + manifest row; steering text (AGENTS.md, R15 body, router known owner gap, solver-quests.md, runbook, solve-commands.json + generated); epic lists the quest and authorizes AGENTS.md; witnesses in test/solve/commands.test.js and test/scripts/pre-push-hook-control-flow.test.js; regenerated inventory and shard metadata.

Correction to the design finding (entry point). The lab cone on attempt 1 (b30380c69) found test/scripts/push-gate-change-proof.test.js 'an exemption holds only while nothing the gate runs names the file' red: the hook ran scripts/solve.js, whose import closure holds scripts/solve/commands.js (land), which names .githooks/pre-commit - so the landed exemption of .githooks/pre-commit (cccf0218e: 'named only by solve land, never at push') would have become false. Attempt 2 removes the solve 'admit' verb and gives the guard owner its own entry: node scripts/solve/guards.js admit --base <remote main sha> --head <pushed main sha> [--json] (guards.js runAdmissionCli; exit 0 admitted, 1 refused naming commits and src/ paths on stderr, 2 usage). The gate's closure now holds the guard, store, schema and proof-authority, not land; the exemption test is green; the solve CLI keeps its six verbs. The other three reds in that run (import closure, observed-by-name, cone) were the fresh scratch worktree lacking the generated import graph, green in the quest worktree. Witnesses now spawn that command; red-first re-measured on d60c30921 with the attempt-2 witnesses: the same 12 of 13 sealed receipts red (behavioural: the command answers nothing and exits 0 there), non-main-push green. Added a 14th witness outside the sealed list (the probe is immutable): a merge proven only through a sibling's release content identity is refused - it kills mutation M6b (resolution not checked), which survived attempt 1.

Mutation table at attempt 2 (scratch worktree, restored after each): M1 digest not compared -> 1 red; M2 land stops writing the binding -> 4; M3 landing log verification dropped -> 1; M4 any terminal, not one new in the commit -> 1; M5 merge receipt dropped -> 2; M6 any proof answer accepted -> 3; M6b identity resolution accepted -> 1; M7 governing quest dropped -> 1; M8 brought commits not covered -> 1; M10 range not cut at the remote main -> 3; M11 first-parent instead of combined merge diff -> 1; M12 merge own paths ignored -> 1; M13 land record guard removed -> 2; M14 append-only half removed -> 1; M15 hook stage removed -> 1; M16 admission on every proved push -> 1; M17 stage after unused-files -> 1; M18 refusal ignored (|| true) -> 1; M19 first pushed sha judged instead of main's -> 1; M20 CLI exits 0 on refusal -> 7. Survivor M9 (rename detection on) is equivalent: land and the admission share RAW_SOURCE_DIFF and under the src pathspec a cross-boundary rename degrades to add/delete either way.
